sugyot.question: Why, per R' Meir, is a sitting woman pure while a standing one is impure?
When a man and a woman stood and urinated into one basin, what would R' Meir rule?
Does R' Meir deem the woman impure in a compound doubt (man and woman standing into one basin)?
To whom may a woman who lent her garment attribute a stain found on it?
